messages:
Maya Nguyen: Quick heads-up — we're scheduling a customer readout for Acme next Wed. Goal: account health + onboarding progress + renewal view. Need 1) 1-slide health snapshot, 2) onboarding status slide, 3) enablement asks & training calendar, 4) consolidated action list. Who can own slides by EOD Fri?

Jordan Patel: I'll take the health snapshot. Will include NPS, usage trends, error spikes and top-3 risks. @Priya — can you drop the last 30-day ingestion & call success numbers?

Priya Rao: Uploading numbers now. Also adding a short note about outstanding integrations. Draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood/acme/readout-draft (v0.1)

Liam O'Connor: I'll own onboarding status. Pulling E2E checklist and training completion. Also will surface renewal sentiment — FYI customer said they're leaning toward a 1yr commit but want pricing options.

Sam Reynolds: Thanks — can we make sure the readout calls out the LLM perf regressions last month? Cost spike + latency hit were notable. Need a short workaround/timeline slide.

Jordan Patel: Good call. I'll add an incident summary + mitigation timeline (2–3 bullets).

Priya Rao: Quick enablement ask draft (for slide): 1) role-based training sessions, 2) integration playbooks, 3) SSO & KMS onboarding docs. Anyone want to add/modify?

Maya Nguyen: @Jordan @Liam @Priya please assign owners in the doc and add due dates. I'm compiling the deck — planning a dry-run Tue 11/7 10:00–10:30. calendar-bot — please create a 30m dry-run event and ping attendees.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Acme Readout dry-run" — Tue 11/7 10:00–10:30. Invited: Maya Nguyen, Jordan Patel, Priya Rao, Liam O'Connor, Sam Reynolds.

Jordan Patel: Uploaded health snapshot v0.1 -> https://drive.redwood/acme/health-v0.1 (comments welcome). My top-3 risks: churn intent on two teams, KV cache regressions affecting throughput, and an undocumented config delaying rollouts.

Priya Rao: Added metrics table and integration checklist to onboarding slide. Flag: we should include a 90s demo clip of the key workflow — @Sam can you record a short walk-through?

Sam Reynolds: Yep, I'll record and upload by Mon EOD.

Liam O'Connor: Drafted renewal-options slide but need final pricing from finance before I lock. @Maya can you loop in finance contact?

Maya Nguyen: Looping finance now (email sent). Also consolidating action items below — please confirm or update in doc.

```
Action items:
- Jordan Patel: finalize health slide (due Fri EOD)
- Liam O'Connor: finalize onboarding + renewal slide (due Fri EOD)
- Priya Rao: integration notes + attach feedback log template (due Mon EOD)
- Sam Reynolds: 2-min screen recording of main workflow (due Mon EOD)
- Maya Nguyen: confirm pricing with finance & compile deck (due Mon EOD)
```

Priya Rao: Added a simple feedback-capture template to the drive (FeedbackLog_v1). Will keep it open for comments.

Jordan Patel: I'll also include a one-slide "Risks & Asks" with explicit asks for execs (e.g., commitment timeline, support SLA).

Maya Nguyen: Perfect. Thanks everyone — see you at the dry-run. :thumbsup:
